label: digit 3 after a p...{u,v,q}{u,v} prefix at step 3-4
explanation: Very sparse feature: 31 activations on 1M sequences. All of them are in the original phase at t=3-5, almost always on input digit 3 (96% of mass). The sequence nearly always starts with p (96%), and the two preceding tokens are from {u,v} (or q two back), e.g. p q v u [3]. The largest activations (max 1.9) are on p q v u 3 at t=4. Shorter p v v 3 / p u v 3 prefixes at t=3 give about 0.2 of max. The rare off-pattern hits (input 2 or q, first token r, prev c/d) are weak. It never fires in the delimiter or copy phase. The conjunctive predicate reaches dev F1 0.82, but with ~20 dev examples it is probably overfit to a handful of specific prefixes.
